title: Three examples run cd ~/some/new/project && dvb install, which stops at cd unless the directory exists, 0258's class (README, shell-init's usage and its page)
body:
Three examples seed a new project with `cd ~/some/new/project && dvb install`, which stops at cd unless the directory already exists, and none says to make it. They are README.md:83, shell-init's usage (lib/cmd/shell-init:71) and its page (lib/pages/shell-init.md:29). This is 0258's class: the README's first example now makes its directory first. Found by dc's critic-shell review of 0258. vc read the three lines on main at 50981f82 and filed it on 2026-10-27.

## Fix

Each example makes the directory before it changes into it, as 0258's README example does: `mkdir -p ~/some/new/project && cd ~/some/new/project && dvb install`.

## Done when

1. Each of the three examples, read from its file and run as written in a scratch home, seeds the project, with a `dvb` that shell-init emitted from a fixture keg. An arm for each, red on main.
2. The landing suite passes under BSD and GNU (documentation, shellinit and help, with the tree scans), and CI is green on the pushed head.

It builds after 0251, which edits lib/pages/shell-init.md, and after 0258.

## Resolution

The dvb example in the README, in shell-init's usage and on its page now makes the project's directory before changing into it: `mkdir -p ~/some/new/project && cd ~/some/new/project && dvb install`. Each was `cd ~/some/new/project && dvb install`, which stops at cd unless the directory is already there, and none said to make it. This is 0258's class, which the README's first example had already been fixed for.

- README.md, lib/cmd/shell-init and lib/pages/shell-init.md carry the new example.
- tests/unit/documentation.bats:
  - `dvb_seeds` reads every line ending ` dvb install` out of a file, refusing an awk that fails and a read of none. It runs each line as written, in a scrubbed fresh home, with the dvb that Homebrew's devbin from a brew_keg keg emits, and checks that the example seeded the project it names and that dvb falls back to the keg's opt link.
  - An arm for each of the three files carries 0269.
  - `reader_seeds` is the one reader harness, which 0258's README arm and dvb_seeds both run through.

### Evidence

- **The landing:** D (stage 7) landed on main as b7ce3b55..39283d9f, one commit per issue. This issue's is 2f372460, `0269: the README's, shell-init's usage's and its page's dvb example make the project's directory before they change into it`. Its stable patch-id equals that of bde34cce, the commit dc handed over in stage 7 (s7b/build, tip e3c9c8bb). bde34cce is kept in ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-dc/cited-archive.git under refs/cited/.
- **No run before the merge:** stage 7's own arms and light (s7b/run7.sh) did not run. D merged on hv's GO, under which no Claude ran a test. The evidence is the runs on main after it.
- **hv's test all on rhadamanth, green at 217adf65:** the seal is tmp/test/20261029-0817.bats.out and .bats.errors. It shows 2777 ok and 0 not ok, 5 of them skips, every test in tests/unit run once. The .errors file is empty.
- **K0116B on kovacs, green at 4d1a76b0:** the full suite, with rustup's cargo proxy first on PATH as on CI's Ubuntu runner, read by vc over ssh on kovacs: k0116b.rc 0, tmp/test/20261029-0909.bats.out 2777 ok and 0 not ok, its .errors empty, the clone's HEAD 4d1a76b0.
- **CI:** run 40851772728 at 4d1a76b0 and run 40860048152 at 25175386 both concluded success: Test on Ubuntu, Shell Script Analysis and Test Summary green, with the WSL and macOS jobs skipped.
- **Fix forward:** none of the fixes between the merge and those runs (caf77878, 217adf65, 4d1a76b0, 25175386) names 0269.

- **CI:** run 40860048152 on the pushed head 25175386, which carries the landing, read green by vc.
